title: Analytics
description: How your clients' accounts and posts perform, across every platform.

insights.title: Highlights
insights.lastYear: compared with the same days last year
insights.followersUp: {count} more followers than at the start of the range.
insights.followersDown: {count} fewer followers than at the start of the range.
insights.topPlatform: {platform} has the best engagement rate, at {rate}.
insights.cadence: About {perWeek} posts a week in this range.

trend.title: Trend
trend.empty: No figures for this range yet.
trend.postsInBucket: {count, plural, one {# post published} other {# posts published}}
trend.moreAccounts: {count, plural, one {# more account is} other {# more accounts are}} left out; the lines show the accounts with the highest totals.

sync.stillRunning: Still syncing. The figures will update on their own when it finishes.

posts.empty: No posts published in this range
posts.emptyDescription: Posts from the connected accounts show up here with their results.

post.title: Post results
post.noMetrics: No results yet. They appear after the next sync, within a few hours.
post.averageOf: Average of {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}
post.historyPending: The history fills in as the post is read each day. Check back tomorrow.

notice.reconnectTitle: {count, plural, one {# account needs} other {# accounts need}} reconnecting for analytics
notice.reconnectBody: They were connected before analytics permissions were asked for. Reconnect them and allow all permissions.
notice.failedTitle: {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} could not be synced
notice.failedBody: Hover the status in the accounts table for the reason. We retry automatically.
notice.pendingTitle: Collecting analytics for {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}}
notice.pendingBody: The first sync runs within half an hour of connecting. Figures then refresh every few hours.

empty.title: No connected accounts yet
empty.description: Connect a client's Facebook Page, Instagram or YouTube channel to see its analytics.

content.truncated: Based on the newest {count} posts in this range.

empty.title: No posts in this range
empty.description: Content insights appear once the accounts have posts in the selected dates.

bestTimes.title: Best times to post
bestTimes.timezone: Average engagements by when posts went out, in {timezone}.
bestTimes.cell: {day} {hour}: {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}, {engagements} average engagements
bestTimes.hint: Hover or focus a cell for details.

recommended.detail: {engagements} average engagements · {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}
recommended.notEnough: Not enough posts yet to recommend times. Keep posting at different times to find what works.

captions.title: Caption length
captions.hint: Average engagements per post by caption length

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.hint: Most-used hashtags and how their posts perform

trends.title: Trends
trends.description: What's popular in a market, and what has been working for these accounts lately.
trends.noCountry: Pick a country to see its trends. Set the client's target markets on the client to make this automatic.
trends.youtubeNote: YouTube's chart covers music, film and gaming.
trends.unavailable: This source isn't available right now. Try again later.

whatWorks.title: Working lately for you
whatWorks.empty: Nothing has clearly beaten these accounts' usual engagement in the last {days} days yet.

empty.title: No audience data yet
empty.description: Instagram shares demographics once an account has 100 followers; YouTube shares its viewers' age, gender and countries. Facebook no longer provides them. Data appears after the next sync.

summary.share: {share} of the audience is in this group.
summary.shareEstimated: About {share} of the audience, estimated from the separate age and gender splits.
summary.none: Not enough audience data to describe the core audience yet.

basis.viewers: Based on YouTube viewers (share of views).
basis.mixed: Blends Instagram followers and YouTube viewers, weighted by account size.

audience.facebookNote: {count, plural, one {# Facebook account} other {# Facebook accounts}} not included: Facebook no longer shares Page demographics.
audience.limits: Platforms don't share interests, languages or income, so the audience is described by age, gender and place only.
audience.menaShare: {share} of the audience is in the Middle East & North Africa (MENA).

report.title: {client}: social media report
report.pickClient: Pick a client in the filters above to build their report.
report.noPosts: No posts were published in this range.

share.title: Share with the client
share.description: A read-only link to this report, always showing the latest days. Anyone with the link can open it, without signing in.
share.revokeConfirm: Revoke this link? It stops working immediately.
share.createdHint: Copy it now: for security it won't be shown again.

public.unavailableHint: The link may have expired or been revoked. Ask the sender for a new one.

schedules.title: Email reports
schedules.description: Email this client's report every week or month. Times are in the client's time zone ({timezone}).
schedules.deleteQuestion: Delete this email schedule? No more reports will be sent.

form.recipientsHint: Type an email and press Enter. Up to {max}.
form.recipientsRequired: Add at least one email address.
form.invalidEmail: One of the addresses isn't a valid email.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Targets for this client, with today's expected pace marked on each bar.
goals.empty: No goals yet. Set a target to track progress against it.
goals.emptyReadOnly: No goals have been set for this client.
goals.deleteQuestion: Delete this goal? Its progress won't be shown any more.

form.metricHint: Counted across all of the client's accounts. Follower growth is net: gained minus lost.
form.periodHint: Days in the client's time zone, up to {max}.
